summary.text: Samuel Price is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 99 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described a background in software engineering and said he directs multiple software teams as a senior technical lead.

paragraphs.text: Samuel Price said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has worked extensively on government contracts and is running to challenge what he described as 30 years of poor leadership, infrastructure and systemic corruption.
He said he is not a career politician and wants to apply an engineer's understanding of technology and infrastructure to issues such as artificial intelligence, data centers and the electrical grid.
His stated priorities include accountability in government contracting, infrastructure, and city planning.
